script.cover_1: Are you online? One question that keeps a junior awake.
script.payoff: Saying what is needed and by when lets the junior sleep.
script.caption: A late question with no reason is a weight on the junior's night. Send this to the boss who pings after dinner.
script.lands: At night the junior may stare at the phone, afraid to answer and afraid not to.
script.better: Need a yes or no on the file. Tomorrow 10 am is fine.
script.why: It says what is needed and when, so the night stays quiet.
